```{r}
#| label: setup

source(here::here("R", "setup.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("R", "load-data.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("R", "kpis.R"), echo = FALSE)

retention_text <- if (is.na(retention_latest$share)) {
  "There is not yet enough snapshot history to report this indicator."
} else {
  sprintf("Currently, **%s** out of **%s members** (**%s**) meet this criterion, %s the target of **\u2265 %d%%**.",
          fmt_n(retention_latest$retained), fmt_n(retention_latest$total),
          fmt_pct(retention_latest$share * 100),
          if (retention_latest$share >= cfg$target_retention) "meeting" else "falling short of",
          round(cfg$target_retention * 100))
}

```

### New Members {#no-member}

Monthly signups show the number of new members joining Collaboratory, reflecting platform growth trends. The cumulative view illustrates total membership over time.

```{r}
#| label: monthly-signups-charts
#| fig-height: 4


ggplot(signups_monthly_filtered, aes(x = Month, y = Total_Signups)) +
  geom_line(color = collab$brand, size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = collab$brand, size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Member Signups",
    subtitle = glue::glue("As of {fmt_date(forum_stats_date)}"),
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "2 months") +
  theme_collab_line()

signups_monthly_cumulative <- signups_monthly_filtered %>%
  arrange(Month) %>%
  mutate(Cumulative_Signups = cumsum(Total_Signups))

ggplot(signups_monthly_cumulative, aes(x = Month, y = Cumulative_Signups)) +
  geom_line(color = collab$brand, size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = collab$brand, size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative Member Signups",
    subtitle = glue::glue("As of {fmt_date(forum_stats_date)}"),
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "2 months") +
  theme_collab_line()
```

### Longterm Retention {#long-ret}

Longterm retention measures the proportion of members who have logged in at least once every `r cfg$retention_gap_days` days over the past `r round(cfg$retention_window_days / 365 * 12)` months, highlighting consistent participation. `r retention_text`
